description: A fabricated match that differs from reality in matchType ALONE: it selects fr, names range fr at weight 1, and considers exactly the loaded locales, so matchType=EXTENDED_RANGE is the only counterfactual field. TranslationResult.isFallback (TranslationResult.java:250-274) ORs negotiationUsedFallback, which switches on the SUPPLIED matchType, with a resolved-locale term that is inert when the key is served from the supplied locale.
